_comment: Read by scripts/ops/check-env-passthrough.py. Every environment variable the backend or the web build reads must reach production through docker-compose.prod.yml AND the Helm chart, unless it is listed here with the reason it must not (or need not) be set in production. Keep entries sorted. nativeBuildTime: variables the Expo app or app.config.ts read at EAS build time; they never reach the servers, so each says where it is set.

backendExempt.APP_VERSION: Baked into the image by release.yml (build arg), reported by /api/info.
backendExempt.DEV_OTP_CONSOLE: Development/staging only: prints OTPs to the log. Must stay unset in production.
backendExempt.EMERGENT_LLM_KEY: Legacy alias read only when LLM_API_KEY is unset; LLM_API_KEY is passed through.
backendExempt.GIT_COMMIT: Baked into the image by release.yml (build arg), reported by /api/info.
backendExempt.JWT_SECRET: Legacy fallback for OTP_HASH_SECRET, which production requires.
backendExempt.PAYMENT_ALLOW_MOCK_IN_PRODUCTION: Lets the mock gateway run in production (moves no money). Must never be set on a public deployment.
backendExempt.PAYMENT_MOCK_SIGNING_KEY: Mock payment gateway only; production refuses PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock.
backendExempt.SCHEDULER_IN_PROCESS: Production runs the separate worker; enabling this in the API replicas would double-run jobs.
backendExempt.SEED_DEMO_DATA: Demo seeding is refused unless APP_ENV is development/testing.
backendExempt.SEED_SCENARIOS: Staging seeding script only; refused unless APP_ENV=testing.

backendDynamicReads.services/integration_config.py:platform_: Reads os.getenv(name.upper()) for platform settings; every such name is also read literally in INTEGRATIONS_DB['platform'], which this check covers.

frontendExempt.VITE_ALLOW_OFFLINE_AUTH: Dev server only (gated on import.meta.env.DEV); never in a production build.
frontendExempt.VITE_DEMO_DATA: Dev server only (gated on import.meta.env.DEV); never in a production build.

nativeBuildTime.EAS_PROJECT_ID: EAS environment variable (docs: eas env:create); app.config.ts extra.eas.projectId.
nativeBuildTime.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: eas.json build.base.env (https://api.studentkare.co/api); CI Expo job sets it too.
nativeBuildTime.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV: eas.json per profile (development / preview / production); the native Sentry environment.
nativeBuildTime.EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN: EAS environment variable; native crash reporting is off without it.
nativeBuildTime.SENTRY_ORG: EAS environment variable; enables the Sentry source-map upload plugin with SENTRY_PROJECT.
